verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an integrations catalog under /integrations/overview with per-integration setup guides. These cover ticketing (Jira, ClickUp), identity/directory (JumpCloud) and FreeAgent, which is used for offboarding and role checks, and the docs claim integration with the customer's cloud stack. The evidence does not show the full breadth of categories the story names, and nothing addresses read-only scopes. Missing for 10: documented read-only/least-privilege scopes, evidence of specific cloud-provider, code-hosting, MDM and HR integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can connect my real stack — cloud providers, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM, ticketing — through a documented integrations catalog with read-only scopes

citations.quote: Sprinto simplifies and automates the path to compliance by integrating with your existing cloud stack, continuously monitoring your systems
